cues: Because marks is private, every change goes through a public setter that can check it.
Set a mark of one hundred and five: rejected.
Write to marks directly from outside: the compiler refuses.
Abstraction is the other side: the user sees only what the object does, not how it is stored.
Encapsulation is how it is hidden; abstraction is what is shown.
